summary: X3DOM is an open source JavaScript framework that draws declarative three-dimensional scenes inside ordinary web pages using the browser's WebGL graphics interface. It follows a web-oriented subset of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard. It covers scene structure, geometry, materials, lights, shadows, animation, navigation, geospatial placement and an optional physics build well, and it reads glTF and X3D content through its Inline node. It leaves identity, payments, shared multi-user worlds and content generation to others. A trap for standards audiences: its own tutorials still say only X3D files are supported although the release notes list glTF 2.0, and several features exist only in an unreleased development section of the change log, so check the version before relying on them.

coverage.note: X3DOM builds a scene graph of nodes with fields, written as markup inside a web page.
